title: The Unveiled Christ
lyrics: [C]Once our blessed Christ of beauty [G]Was veiled off from human [C]view;
[C]But through suffering, death and sorrow [Dm7]He has rent the [G7]veil in [C]two.
[F]O behold the Man of [C]Sorrows, [F]O [D7]behold Him in plain [G7]view;
[C]Lo! He [D7]is the [C]mighty [F]Conqueror, [C]Since He [G]rent the veil in [C]two.
[F]Lo! He is the mighty [C]Conqueror, [G]Since He [G7]rent the veil in [C]two.
Yes, He is with God, the Father,
For He is the Well beloved
Since He rent the veil in two.
Men of earth give praises due;
For He is the mighty Conqueror
Since He rent the veil in two.
